node.statement: Dependency-correct supremum bridge: using only validated nodes 1.1 and 1.3, fix an arbitrary admissible exposer h. Node 1.1 gives L_F=sum_{f in F} w_f>0 and w_f>=0, hence min_{f in F} h(p_f) <= (sum_{f in F} w_f h(p_f))/L_F. Node 1.3 gives sum_{f in F} w_f h(p_f) <= nu_v, so min_{f in F} h(p_f) <= nu_v/L_F for every admissible h. Since def-exposed defines t*(v) as the supremum of these minima over admissible h, and every member of that set is bounded above by nu_v/L_F, the supremum is also bounded above by nu_v/L_F. Thus the deduction no longer requires pending node 1.4.
